column4: Run the read-only study coordinator self-test and live status report from the current repository root, then write a dated receipt under docs/task-receipts/ with exact commands, exit codes, emitted phase statuses, artifact paths/mtimes or hashes, and the exact safe next action. Do not capture device data, contact external services, publish, write the router, or perform any irreversible step. Acceptance: both coordinator commands exit 0, the receipt preserves UNKNOWN/NO-BASIS/GATED_OPERATOR_GO semantics, and the result is observed on pane:adint.
